explanation: Pudlák, 'Incompleteness in the finite domain' (arXiv:1601.01487, §6): a proof system for SAT is a polytime function from Σ* onto SAT, and the conjecture (SAT) is that SAT has no p-optimal proof system. IsProofSystem (polytime, range exactly L), PSimulates (polytime translation h with P∘h = Q) and IsPOptimalProofSystem follow Cook–Reckhow. The statement is made for every NP-complete L instead of SAT; this is equivalent because p-optimal proof systems pass down along many-one reductions (Köbler–Messner–Torán 2003) and all NP-complete sets are many-one equivalent to SAT. Faithful.
